folded: Nov 16, 2026: unsleeve; the main Winter Soldier deck is the one Bucky deck. Freed cards: Captain America's Shield, Swordsman's Steel, Captain America, Liberator, Bucky Barnes, Eager Ally, Origin of Captain America and Take Up the Shield go to Captain America: Shield Throw. Iron Man Armor goes to King T'Challa. Red Guardian and Foggy Nelson go to King T'Challa. From the History of Heroes kit, Damn, With Great Power... and a second Rogue's Gloves were aimed here; Damn and With Great Power... are now spare.
name: Winter Soldier: Lone Assassin
notes: Winter Soldier has vigilance and menace and gets +2/+0 for each Equipment attached. He attacks alone into a hand full of cheap removal, picks up value from every attack-alone card, and comes back from the graveyard with an Equipment already on.

Turns 1–3: Winter Soldier on turn two. He's a Villain, so Baron Strucker and Tombstone make him cheaper; Sol Ring, Arcane Signet and Fellwar Stone speed you up. Add cheap gear: S.H.I.E.L.D. Spy Kit, Stolen Stark Tech, Vibranium Energy Daggers or Infinity Formula. Bucky gets +2/+0 for each Equipment on him.

Turns 4–6: Attack alone each turn. Agent 13 investigates, Crimson Cowl makes a 2/1 menace Villain, Black Widow, Double Agent gives first strike on top of menace, and Nick Fury, Spymaster draws a card and drops a creature into the attack. Swordsman reattaches gear whenever a Villain enters; Whiplash drains per Equipment.

Closing: With two or three Equipment, Winter Soldier swings for 8+ menace damage each turn. If he dies, leave him in the graveyard: {3}{W}{B} brings him back with an Equipment attached and dodges commander tax.

Bracket 2: Bucky's people: Sharon Carter (Agent 13), Natasha (Black Widow, Double Agent), Yelena (White Widow), Red Guardian, U.S.Agent, Sam Wilson (The Falcon), Steve Rogers (Captain America, Liberator), young Bucky, Peggy Carter, Nick Fury, Zemo twice (Baron Zemo and Citizen V) and the Thunderbolts Conspiracy. Gear: 15 Equipment (Whispersilk Cloak makes him unblockable; Boots and Greaves protect him) plus Sword of the Animist, Super-Soldier Serum, Alien Symbiosis and two Sturdy Shield tokens. Protection: Bastion Protector, Peggy Carter, Foggy Nelson, Matt Murdock and Take Up the Shield. Twelve removal spells including Swords to Plowshares and Path to Exile. Captain America, Liberator is the only tutor; no combos or extra turns.

Set tags: MSH = Marvel Super Heroes, SPM = Marvel's Spider-Man, MSC = Marvel Super Heroes Commander and Jumpstart cards. Every card listed is one you own. Hot Dog Cart and Dependable Quinjet are in all five Marvel B2 decks; some other commons and uncommons are shared too.

variants.name: Lone Assassin (Nov 15 tune)
notes: Nov 15 generic sim: this is the best Marvel Bracket 2 deck (37% in four-player pods, where 25% is average). Leave the mana alone: Command Tower, two Thriving lands, Night's Whisper and Thought Vessel together changed nothing (37.9% to 37.0%).

Whiplash was the one clearly weak card: he enters tapped and his drain needs Equipment that belongs on Winter Soldier. Skullclamp is still an Equipment for the +2/+0. Night's Whisper is the alternative if the Skullclamp is busy elsewhere.
